title: Prove five-root minimum for eight-source paired-call connectors
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

PR2282 leaves open whether four arbitrary dirty root rows can handle every eight-source mask with exactly two complete calls per source and output map. This proves they cannot: **five roots are necessary and sufficient** in that scalar-F2-frame, immutable-source, offline-output model. The five-root construction is conorholds/PR2182's star, independently replayed and credited.

The new proof reduces relevant paired source words to `n!` double-permutation orders and root axes to binary row spaces containing all ones. Independent Python and C++ engines exclude every one of **40,320 × 11,811 = 476,219,520** reduced eight-source cases. A general mask-intersection feasibility criterion and a constructive, fully charged frame compiler accompany the exclusion. This is a scoped computer-assisted interface result, not a physical supplier, transfer-cost optimum or new kappa.

Only `research/eight-source-root-code/` is added. The credited upper bill is five dirty roots, 16 B calls, 510 A calls and 120 paid full-row XORs, with all complete-port prices and remaining physical obligations stated in the README.

## Task and overlap

Task `connector-alphabet-change`, **changed** scope: follow merged PR2282's explicit eight-source handoff after live overlap exposed that it already settles seven sources. Discovery base `7788b59946ebf3803dc38b6a19b47b4acb27f40b`; the isolated branch was fast-forwarded to canonical main `12edc35a354c809e0ab01a3c093a2175450ec80c` before submission. Relevant guidance, selected record and predecessor inputs are unchanged. Picker nonce `ceb645200d35eb9706fafdcc129b4ead`, priority revision 5.

Exact predecessor heads: PR2282 `74e57135608dade29029a1107fdfceec8419c932`; PR2182 `dc252de1cc594829c3031abdb4de104713bc474a`. Coordination and scope history: [Discussion2785](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2785). TASK.json records complete source pins, stop/expansion decision and overlap coverage. The final open-PR refresh covered 722 PRs; full Discussion refresh failed on a connection reset, so the 1,425-record complete snapshot was supplemented by a fresh 30-active-thread/last-ten-comments check. No exact external eight-source overlap was found; this is not a novelty guarantee.

## Validation

On macOS arm64, CPython 3.12.14 and Apple Clang:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/eight-source-root-code
c++ -O3 -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Werror research/eight-source-root-code/census.cpp -o /tmp/eight-root-census
/tmp/eight-root-census > /tmp/eight-root-native.json
python3.12 -I -O -B research/eight-source-root-code/verify.py --native-result /tmp/eight-root-native.json
```

All pass. Normal and optimized Python receipts agree. Native comparison checks the entire code inventory and both histograms, not just the zero. Controls cover all 1,069 small paired words, the known seven-source exclusion, n=4..8 dirty star words/inverses, 646 star omissions, 130 compiled-word omissions, wrong port/direction, insufficient code and typed receipt corruption. The default registered command recomputes every Python case without a native receipt.

Not run: hosted CI, proof-assistant or independent human review, selected cold replay, physical caller/stock/hosting/tape/precision admission or outer transfer. No selected construction or upstream source changes.

## Credit

Credit Mason Hale/PR2282 for the seven-source theorem, mandatory-mask method and handoff; conorholds/PR2182 for normalized axes, contracts and the star; Ross Richardson/PR934/943, Douglas Colkitt/PR1185 and the retained multi-root/compiler lineage. New work by Arham Tahir with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0; no predecessor executable is imported. Separate engines are AI-assisted implementations, not human peer review.

## Open next questions

The package README and TASK.json ask for one actual recursive caller and complete paid budget before another construction campaign, or a caller-specific extra-call/root-stock tradeoff. Root count alone does not establish profitability; no nine-source expansion is proposed.
